usage: The word "窗台" refers to the flat surface directly below a window, commonly found inside or outside buildings.
"窗台" functions as a noun and can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
You can describe items placed on or near the windowsill using "窗台" followed by a verb.
"窗台" often appears in home or furniture related conversations, especially when talking about decorations or house maintenance.
It is common to talk about the size, condition, or what is placed on the 窗台 in daily speech.
